model.template: unchanged canonical Llama-2 Chat tokenizer template
model.limitation: Llama-3.2 to Llama-2 changes generation/architecture as well as size; not a pure parameter-count ablation

fingerprints.oversampling_reason: existing official whitespace validity filter; freeze first 1024 valid pairs, not a larger training set
fingerprints.key_generator: same canonical Llama-2-7b-chat-hf, explicit instruction-tuned branch

training.released_code_difference: released callback checks eval_loss, not the paper/user-requested training loss
training.optimizer: released Trainer AdamW / DeepSpeed CPUAdam implementation; paper describes Adam
training.wa_reference_placement: GPU; unchanged immutable BF16 weights and official averaging expression; CPU placement exhausted host memory during initialization

pilot.detector: existing greedy first-token exact match on fixed1024, paired clean Base control
pilot.utility_proxy: fixed first64 canonical ARC-Challenge test examples, unchanged chat harness and acc_norm; existing10-prompt ordinary-generation check
pilot.utility_proxy_limitation: small diagnostic sample; not full utility or a tinyBenchmarks estimator

formal.teacher_gate_reference: existing A2 preferred gate >=0.9 recall and no severe ordinary-generation collapse; inspect utility deltas
